visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female creator with short black hair, wearing glasses and a crisp white collared shirt, is seen in a brightly lit retail environment. She holds a yellow Biotherm sunscreen tube in her right hand, turning it carefully to examine its surface and the 50+ logo. Her expression is curious as she explores the product's texture. Shelves filled with various orange and yellow skincare containers are visible in the background, along with a smartphone she holds in her left hand. (2) The camera remains at a medium-close distance as the woman addresses the viewer directly, her expression shifting to one of impressed surprise. She points toward the product while speaking with animated facial movements. A blue and white wave emoji with text appears as an overlay. In the background, other shoppers in casual attire move through the store aisles under bright studio-style lighting. (3) The screen transitions to a clean, white graphic backdrop featuring the dark grey logo for DRX Dermatology Clinic. The frame contains several text blocks organized vertically, including a Line social media handle, a phone number, and two physical addresses in Taiwan. The layout is static and professional, concluding with a friendly Contact us slogan at the bottom.
